technical-summary: Removed runtime-owner hardcoded generated/v2 include paths so production sources consume the generated edition selected by their linked manifest target. Removed a duplicate explicit v2 codec include from P1 producer. This is a build-seam refactor; it does not activate the v3 edition or native YAML production launch.
user-summary-candidate: Reduced generated-v2 hardcoding in the serving runtime so the same sources can follow the manifest edition selected by CMake, a prerequisite for the native YAML migration.
